notes:           PrismarineJS/minecraft-data does NOT commit a standalone
                 LICENSE file. The licence is declared inline in
                 README.md §License (lines 145-149 at the pinned SHA above)
                 as "MIT" with a note about source attribution. Our
                 third_party/minecraft-data/LICENSE reproduces that
                 declaration verbatim with provenance.

                 Per the vendoring pattern (DECISIONS.md 2026-06-18,
                 third_party/README.md): the git-sha above is the
                 load-bearing record; git-ref is informational. The
                 file-sha256 values let a future reader fetch the upstream
                 commit and byte-diff against the vendored files.

                 Vendored read-only. Customisation goes through the
                 extractor (scripts/extract_block_colors.py) which reads
                 these files + the user's MC client jar PNGs to produce
                 data/block_palette_db.csv. The C++ loader (src/palette.cpp)
                 reads these files + the CSV at runtime; no patches to the
                 vendored copies.
